title: Sine
subtitle: Trigonometric · Periodic
summary: Ratio of opposite to hypotenuse. Period 2π.
detail:
\[ \sin x = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^n x^{2n+1}}{(2n+1)!} \]

Odd function: \(\sin(-x)=-\sin x\). Period \(2\pi\). Range \([-1,1]\). Key identity: \(\sin^2 x+\cos^2 x=1\). Taylor series converges for all \(x\).
